title: Somatic symptom and related disorders
summary: Somatic symptom disorder, illness anxiety disorder, or conversion disorder meeting paragraph A criteria, AND paragraph B (functional limitations).

children.criterion: Medical documentation of one of: changed motor/sensory functioning, somatic symptom with disproportionate concern, or preoccupation with serious illness
Symptoms of altered voluntary motor or sensory function not better explained by another medical condition
One or more somatic symptoms that are distressing, with excessive thoughts/feelings/behaviors related to the symptoms
Preoccupation with having or acquiring a serious illness without significant symptoms present
Extreme limitation of one, OR marked limitation of two, of the four areas
Marked/extreme limitation: understand, remember, apply information
Marked/extreme limitation: concentrate, persist, maintain pace
